title: CPA
tagline: A protocol that can help other protocol grow by optimizing their marketing spends.
description: This project will allow protocol to create a campaign, setting the targeting amount of new users, the max bid for onboarding one user, and the criteria & requirement for claiming the reward. Later, the influencers who wants to help promote can accept and campaign and will create some collab nft which can somehow turn into a promo code system. The influencers will only be paid after a follower who minted the collab nft complete the criteria the protocol set (which means a 100% conversion rate from marketing budget to user acquisition)
how_its_made: The project would leverage the op ecosystem and will be deployed on op, Base, Zora, and Mode, also it will be using Hyperlance and LayerZero to provide the best user experience for an omnichain experience. User's on-chain interactions would be retrieved using the Graph and Covalent. Last but not least, in order to prevent Sybil, we will be using the World id to identify whether it's an actual human or not.
